text.arabic_uthmani: قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

words.gloss_range: commissioned saying that launches a proof-demand and identity correction
words.root_gloss_range: speech, utterance, assertion, report, and public position; here narrowed to an authorized imperative that voices the challenge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following show-me imperative that turns commanded speech into proof demand
the corrective identity clause reached by the opening command

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) begins the ayah as commanded speech before the opponents' claim is tested. The hidden singular addressee and clipped Form I imperative make the refutation a commissioned public utterance, not an anonymous argument. The q-w-l field adds accountability: the claim must cross into speech, then immediately into the demand {{ar:أَرُونِىَ}} ({{tr:arūniya}}), so what was assumed has to become showable. Its hard qāf-lām launch makes the command audibly terse, while the same-surah and wider command formula move toward {{ar:هُوَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:huwa Allāhu}}), making the command-to-identification arc part of the ayah's structure.

topics.headline: commissioned speech opens the challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refutation enter as authorized commanded speech before any denial is stated.
topics.reason: The word is a second masculine singular imperative governing the quoted challenge that follows.

topics.headline: speech makes the claim answerable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partner claim is forced into accountable utterance before it is required to produce evidence.
topics.reason: The q-w-l field supports declared speech and held positions, while the local imperative narrows the active sense to commissioned public saying.

topics.headline: say becomes show me
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the opening movement from commanded saying into a demand for demonstrable proof before the denial arrives.
topics.reason: The command precedes the show-me imperative and delays categorical denial until after the evidentiary summons.

topics.headline: compact command in wider formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a terse command that also recalls a broader Quranic command-formula for polemical declaration.
topics.reason: Critical rows connect the clipped imperative with same-surah command recurrence, cross-surah command formula, and the hard opening sound.

words.gloss_range: plural imperative to make the speaker see, with both personal recipient and displayed object
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, showing, perception, opinion, and proof-display; here narrowed to causative showing as evidentiary challenge

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَاءَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna alḥaqtum bihi shurakāʾa}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the full relative object phrase summoned for display
the categorical denial following the proof demand

words.prose: {{ar:أَرُونِىَ}} ({{tr:arūniya}}) turns the speech command into a public proof demand. Its Form IV imperative does not ask the opponents merely to think or report; it orders them to make the alleged partners visible or knowable to the singular speaker. The 2mp form distributes the burden across the addressed group, while the suffix keeps the examiner inside the verb. The object remains open until {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَاءَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna alḥaqtum bihi shurakāʾa}}) completes it, so the whole attached-partner proposition is summoned for display before {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) cancels it. The accepted final-vowel lightening keeps the command moving into its object, and the prior judgment scene makes this showing feel like immediate evidentiary procedure.

topics.headline: show me governs recipient and exhibit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the command demands an exhibit for the speaker, not a vague explanation of belief.
topics.reason: The imperative has a first-person object suffix and governs the following relative-pronoun object with its clause.

topics.headline: causative seeing tests proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing language becomes a demand for demonstrability, while broader sight and opinion senses are locally harnessed to proof.
topics.reason: Form IV licenses causing someone to see or know; the challenge frame narrows the broad r-ʾ-y range to evidentiary display.

topics.headline: many challenged before one examiner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the public burden placed on the plural audience while the requested showing is directed to one inspecting speaker.
topics.reason: The fused imperative is second masculine plural with a first-person singular object suffix.

topics.headline: evidence summons before refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial land as the answer to a failed evidentiary summons rather than as an unsupported assertion.
topics.reason: The command precedes the categorical stop, and the object phrase is completed before the denial particle.

topics.headline: variant pacing keeps the challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational pacing and the previous judicial frame sharpen the demand without changing its grammar.
topics.reason: The accepted vowel-lightening row preserves imperative morphology, while boundary rows place the command inside the prior adjudication setting.

words.gloss_range: masculine rational plural relative pronoun whose referents remain dependent on the following clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following clause that defines the relative pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) gives the demanded exhibit a definite grammatical slot without supplying names. Because the relative pronoun needs its following clause, the alleged partners remain suspended until the audience's own act, {{ar:أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَاءَ}} ({{tr:alḥaqtum bihi shurakāʾa}}), defines them. Its rational plural form lets the opponents' person-like grammar stand for examination, but the ayah withholds independent identity before rejecting the class.

topics.headline: identity waits for the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the alleged partners are not independently named; they depend on the opponents' own attachment clause.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun functions as the object of the show-me verb and requires the following ṣilah for identification.

topics.headline: person-like grammar without identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah allows person-like plural grammar for the claimed objects while refusing to grant them names.
topics.reason: The masculine rational plural form is definite but semantically empty until the attached clause supplies content.

topics.headline: demand first, definition later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the show-me demand open before the alleged set can be defined.
topics.reason: The object pronoun appears before its defining relative clause is completed.

words.gloss_range: second-plural completed act of annexing or attaching alleged partners to Him
words.root_gloss_range: catching up, joining, attaching, affiliating, and appending; here narrowed to causative annexation by the addressees

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the prepositional complement fixing the attachment point
the status noun assigned by the attachment verb

words.prose: {{ar:أَلْحَقْتُم}} ({{tr:alḥaqtum}}) defines the alleged objects through the audience's own completed action. Its Form IV and -tum ending make the addressees the causers of attachment, so the partner relation is treated as imposed classification rather than discovered divinity. The required {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) fixes the attachment point, and the later status noun {{ar:شُرَكَاءَ}} ({{tr:shurakāʾa}}) shows what title they assigned. The rare, heavy l-ḥ-q verb carries the image of joining after distance as secondary-attachment pressure, while local grammar keeps it in the polemical frame of wrongful annexation.

topics.headline: addressees caused the annexation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees responsibility placed on the addressed group as the agents who made the attachment claim.
topics.reason: The token is a Form IV perfect second masculine plural verb.

topics.headline: attachment as imposed classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that shirk is pictured as annexing entities into a class where they do not belong.
topics.reason: The l-ḥ-q evidence supports joining and affiliation, but the local Form IV with a bi-phrase narrows it to human-caused annexation.

topics.headline: late joining undercuts co-originality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels alleged partners as appended after the fact, not as co-original divine rivals.
topics.reason: The root image of catching up and joining survives as color, while local syntax prevents treating the partners as genuinely joined to God.

topics.headline: relative clause defines the exhibit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the show-me object defined by the incriminating act before the status noun appears.
topics.reason: The verb sits inside the relative clause, governs the bi-phrase, and precedes the partner-status noun.

topics.headline: marked attachment verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the unusual attachment root and heavy sound as part of the accusation's markedness.
topics.reason: Critical rows treat the root as uncommon, compare 52:21 agency, and note the consonant weight of the verb.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third masculine singular suffix marking the referent to whom the alleged partners were attached

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the verb governing the prepositional phrase
the explicit divine name resolving the suffix referent
the independent pronoun resuming the suffix referent

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) is the small hinge of the attachment claim. Governed by {{ar:أَلْحَقْتُم}} ({{tr:alḥaqtum}}), it marks the point to which the addressees claim partners were fastened, so the issue is not partners in general but partners attached to Him. The suffix comes before the explicit name {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}), letting the referent travel through a bound pronoun in the false frame and then reappear freely as {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) in the correction. The bāʾ contact value gives the rejected claim a felt adhesion before the ayah breaks it.

topics.headline: bi marks the attachment point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the disputed relation fixed to Him specifically rather than left as generic partner language.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is governed by the attachment verb as its complement.

topics.headline: bound pronoun before explicit name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the referent held in a pronoun inside the false attachment frame before the correction names Him.
topics.reason: The suffix precedes the explicit divine name and is resumed by the independent pronoun before naming.

topics.headline: adhesion image in the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the claim as attempted fastening, while local denial keeps that contact value inside a rejected relation.
topics.reason: The bāʾ supports association and contact, but the following denial prevents treating the attachment as real.

words.gloss_range: accusative plural status noun for claimed partners or sharers under challenge
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, co-ownership, association, and entanglement; here narrowed to alleged divine association assigned by the addressees

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attachment verb that assigns the partner status
the prepositional phrase narrowing partnership to claimed divine association
the immediate denial after the partner noun

words.prose: {{ar:شُرَكَآءَ}} ({{tr:shurakāʾa}}) is where the claimed status finally appears. As an accusative plural after {{ar:أَلْحَقْتُم}} ({{tr:alḥaqtum}}), it can be read as state or second object, but either way partnerhood is assigned under challenge rather than granted as independent identity. The sh-r-k field makes the claim one of shared portion, authority, or co-agency; local grammar narrows that to alleged divine association with {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}). Its broken plural makes the rivals countable enough to be demanded as an exhibit, while the snare-and-entanglement image and long plural sound press right up against the immediate {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}), which rejects the whole class.

topics.headline: partnerhood as assigned status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees partnerhood grammatically contained as a status assigned by the addressees.
topics.reason: The accusative noun follows the attachment verb and is licensed as ḥāl or second object, both status readings.

topics.headline: shared authority claim denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not mere plurality; it claims shared entitlement, but the local frame holds that claim under proof and denial.
topics.reason: The root supports sharing and partnership, while the bi-phrase and denial narrow the sense to alleged divine association being refuted.

topics.headline: countable alleged partners
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the claim made enumerable and displayable, not left as an abstract idea of association.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative broken plural concrete noun with no proper names or suffix.

topics.headline: partner language brought to exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this partner noun with prior and parallel exposure scenes while keeping the local act-status pair in view.
topics.reason: Critical rows link 34:22 and 6:22 to the local relation between the attachment verb and the partner noun.

topics.headline: plural entanglement before cancellation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the attempted binding and inflated plural sound at the edge immediately struck by denial.
topics.reason: The snare image and sound rows are locally useful as imagery, but they remain subordinate to the denied partner-status claim.

words.gloss_range: categorical repudiation particle rejecting the completed partner proposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following corrective particle

words.prose: {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) lands only after the show-me phrase has named the whole attached-partner proposition. Its force is therefore not a correction of one noun but a categorical stop over the claim as a unit. The particle rebukes and halts the inference, standing as its own compact beat before {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) redirects the discourse. Its geminated sound gives refusal weight at exactly the boundary between evidentiary demand and identity correction.

topics.headline: categorical stop over the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial cancel the entire attached-partner proposition, not merely modify one word.
topics.reason: The particle follows the completed challenge phrase and precedes the corrective clause.

topics.headline: rebuke before replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the false frame stopped before the ayah installs the true identity frame.
topics.reason: The sequence uses denial plus correction to exclude the partner frame and move to the named referent.

topics.headline: heavy one-word refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the refusal as a compact, weighty interruption rather than smooth coordination.
topics.reason: The particle forms a standalone beat with geminated lām before the adversative transition.

words.gloss_range: adversative corrective particle replacing the rejected partner frame with identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding denial particle
the identity clause introduced by the corrective particle

words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the turn from cancellation to replacement. After {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}), it does not add another clause to the false series; it redirects the discourse into {{ar:هُوَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:huwa Allāhu}}) as the true identity frame. The short particle makes the hinge swift: stop, then correction. Across the boundary from the previous procedural judgment, the ayah moves into immediate invalidation and replacement.

topics.headline: replacement not addition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the identity clause replacing the rejected partner frame rather than continuing it.
topics.reason: The particle follows the repudiation and introduces the corrective nominal clause.

topics.headline: stop then turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah's center as a two-step hinge: denial first, identity replacement second.
topics.reason: The sequence of particles links the stop to the positive identity clause.

topics.headline: quick audible correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a clipped corrective turn after the heavy refusal and sees the prior procedure interrupted by immediate correction.
topics.reason: Sound and boundary rows treat the particle as a compact hinge from previous procedure into replacement.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person pronoun focusing the referent before the divine name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earlier bound pronoun in the attachment phrase
the identity phrase begun by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the correction a focused deictic center before the name arrives. The referent who was bound inside {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) now stands as an independent pronoun, released from the attachment phrase and set as the subject of a nominal identity clause. That shift from bound suffix to detached pronoun changes the frame from human annexing action to stable identification: {{ar:هُوَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:huwa Allāhu}}).

topics.headline: focused referent before the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction pauses on the referent before naming Him, creating an emphatic reset.
topics.reason: The pronoun is independent and nominative before the proper name in the corrective nominal clause.

topics.headline: released from the attachment phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same referent move from a bound suffix in the false relation to a free pronoun in correction.
topics.reason: The suffix in the bi-phrase is resumed by the independent pronoun before the explicit name.

topics.headline: stable identity replaces action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the discourse shift from the audience's action of attaching to a stable identity statement.
topics.reason: The pronoun begins a nominal clause after the verbal attachment frame.

topics.headline: pronoun reprise across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links this identity correction with the prior divine-judgment clause through repeated independent pronoun use.
topics.reason: The boundary row links the current independent pronoun to the prior title clause's referential frame.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name identifying the referent after correction
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship-reference, refuge, bewildered turning, and exalted orientation; here narrowed to the proper name that closes the partner class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the independent pronoun before the proper name
the identity frame containing the proper name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the referent after denial and pronoun focus. As a nominative proper name after {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), it is not one member of the accusative partner set; it replaces class-language with singular identity. The following titles attach to the name, so the correction does not end at naming but expands into attribute-based refutation. The ʾ-l-h field and the familiar {{ar:هُوَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:huwa Allāhu}}) identity frame recall exclusion logic, including 112:1 and 20:14, while local grammar keeps the payoff precise: appended partners collapse before the named God.

topics.headline: proper name closes the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the correction move from plural partner class language to the unique proper name.
topics.reason: The token is a nominative definite proper name after the independent pronoun, not a common deity noun.

topics.headline: attributes attach to the named referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the following titles as part of the correction's grounding, not detachable ornament.
topics.reason: The two nominative definite titles agree with and attach to the proper name after the pronoun.

topics.headline: true orientation after failed attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the name as the true focus of worship and orientation after the false attachment frame collapses.
topics.reason: The root-dispute material is meaningful as background orientation and worship-reference, but the local form selects the proper divine name.

topics.headline: identity formula answers plurality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the identity formula answer plural partners with exclusionary singular naming.
topics.reason: Critical echo rows connect the local formula with 112:1 and the exclusion logic of 20:14 while preserving the local partner-refutation context.

topics.headline: delayed name resolves the argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the name arrive only after the false claim is exposed, tying the challenge to the surah's broader divine-name argument.
topics.reason: Rows identify delayed naming after pronoun and denial, with same-surah recurrence and command-to-identification movement.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative divine title naming invulnerable, unmatched might in the corrective seal
words.root_gloss_range: might, inaccessibility, rarity, reinforcement, hardness, and invulnerability; here narrowed to the title of unoverpowered strength that denies need for support

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the named referent modified by the title
the attachment verb answered by the title
the plural partner noun contrasted with the singular title
the paired closing title

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzu}}) makes might part of the correction itself. Definite and nominative after {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}), it is not a loose epithet or another power; it locks onto the named referent as the first title in the closing pair. The ʿ-z-z field brings invulnerability, inaccessibility, reinforcement, and rarity into view: after {{ar:أَلْحَقْتُم}} ({{tr:alḥaqtum}}), the title answers the logic of supplement by naming a power that cannot be completed by appended partners. Its faʿīl durability and singular definiteness stand against plural {{ar:شُرَكَاءَ}} ({{tr:shurakāʾa}}), then pair with {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmu}}) so the refutation is power joined to wise rule.

topics.headline: title locked to the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees might as part of the corrective identification, not as a detachable descriptive afterthought.
topics.reason: The title is definite and nominative, agreeing with the proper name in the final nominal clause.

topics.headline: unoverpowered power needs no support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the title answer the attachment verb by making external reinforcement unnecessary and incoherent.
topics.reason: The root evidence includes strengthening and invulnerability, but local title usage narrows it to divine might that refutes supplemental partners.

topics.headline: unmatched, not shareable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the title denies not only weakness but substitutability or shared access to divine power.
topics.reason: Rare, hard-to-reach, and impregnable senses survive as title color, while the local sense remains the divine title of might.

topics.headline: stable singular might against plural rivals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees durable singular title-form stand against the imagined plural partner class.
topics.reason: The faʿīl title presents stable quality, and its singular definite form contrasts with plural partner language.

topics.headline: first half of power-wisdom seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears power as the first half of a recurrent paired seal that grounds the whole refutation.
topics.reason: Critical rows identify the strong ʿazīz-ḥakīm pairing, same-surah recurrence, and closing title cadence.

words.gloss_range: final definite nominative divine title naming wise, ordered governance
words.root_gloss_range: judgment, ruling, restraint, wisdom, arbitration, firm-making, and precise ordering; here narrowed to the divine title of wise governance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the named referent modified by the title
the paired title that precedes this final title

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmu}}) gives the ayah its final landing. It agrees with {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) and pairs with {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīzu}}), so the correction ends not with force alone but with wise governance. The ḥ-k-m field brings judgment, restraint, firm ordering, and arbitration into the title: after the proof demand and denial, the final word identifies the one whose rule judges the claim itself and leaves no gap for co-governors. Its faʿīl durability and final position seal the movement from plural partner assertion to singular, ordered rule, echoing the surah opening at 34:1 and handing forward into purposeful sending in 34:28.

topics.headline: final title locks to the correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wisdom and governance as the ayah's final corrective landing, attached to the named referent.
topics.reason: The word is a definite nominative title agreeing with the proper name and occupying final position.

topics.headline: ordered rule needs no co-governors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title answers distributed control by naming wisdom as firm, ordered rule.
topics.reason: The ḥ-k-m field supports judgment, restraint, and firm ordering; the local title narrows this to divine wise governance.

topics.headline: judging restraint at the dispute's close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final title as controlled judgment over the very claim the ayah has staged.
topics.reason: The bridle, restraint, and arbitration images remain useful as controlled-rule pressure, but do not replace the title's local function.

topics.headline: stable title closes plurality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees enduring wise governance close the plural challenge rather than occasional cleverness or borrowed counsel.
topics.reason: The faʿīl title presents settled quality, and its definite singular form follows the plural partner claim.

topics.headline: wisdom completes the power pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closure as power balanced by wise judgment, not force alone.
topics.reason: Critical rows treat the ʿazīz-ḥakīm pair as recurrent and locally important for the attribute-based refutation.

topics.headline: opening title returns at the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final title with 34:1 and sees ordered rule continue into the sending frame of 34:28.
topics.reason: Critical echo and boundary rows explicitly link the title to 34:1 and the next ayah's sending mission.

topics.headline: audible final seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pacing move from clipped denial and correction into the measured final title cadence.
topics.reason: Sound rows describe the transition from short particles to the final long-cadence title pair.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ أَرُونِيَ الَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِ شُرَكَاءَ
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered command requires the addressees to convert an asserted association into an inspectable referent and an intelligible joining relation. The causative attachment makes them authors of the relation, while partnership specifies the shared stake they must exhibit.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance makes the challenge a public command rather than an inward supposition.
Causative showing supplies the demanded move from assertion to presented evidence.
Making one thing reach and join another locates the disputed linkage in the addressees' act.
A shared stake defines what the alleged attached parties would have to possess.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply denies that other gods exist.
changed_reading.after: The ayah places a burden of production on the claimants: present the alleged co-participants and the relation by which they acquired a share.

baseline_models.mechanism: The affiliation branch of attachment and the affinal branch of partnership activate a juridical or genealogical graft. The partners are not discovered as inherently related to God; they are assigned a status by the addressees, and the corrective كَلَّا بَلْ annuls that assignment.

activation_trace.role: Attaching an affiliate to a group or false lineage supplies the image of an attributed status without native belonging.
Affinal and neighboring partnership sharpens the disputed relation as a manufactured kin-like association.
Judgment supplies the authority that rejects the unauthorized affiliation.

changed_reading.before: The error is only numerical, adding more deities.
changed_reading.after: The error is also relational forgery: the claimants confer a partner-status that has no valid affiliation to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The rejection and replacement move from alleged plural associates to the singular divine identity. Unanswerable dominance and right judgment do not describe the strongest member of a coalition; together they remove any functional need or jurisdiction for a co-ruler.

activation_trace.role: The worshiped one supplies the singular identity installed after the rejection.
Overcoming power excludes a rival able to compel or counterbalance Him.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment excludes a co-adviser needed to correct divine rule.

changed_reading.before: God is asserted to be stronger and wiser than competing powers.
changed_reading.after: The alleged competition is categorically replaced by a singular locus of worship, unconquered power, and right governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah admits striking nondivine action while marking it as licensed, commanded, and cognitively limited. This revises a blanket denial of secondary agency: the focus rejects the promotion of dependent agents into holders of a shared divine stake.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation is the status whose legitimacy must be distinguished from mere action.
Purposeful work confirms that a secondary being can genuinely act.
Permission makes that genuine action dependent rather than co-sovereign.
The hidden domain from which the workers are excluded supplies a decisive cognitive limit.
An intercessor joins another's case, showing a real mediating relation that is still not independent partnership.
The repeated permission gate keeps mediation within divine authorization.

structural_cues: 34:12 places powerful labor before Solomon under the Lord's permission and command.
34:14 reveals the workers' ignorance only when Solomon falls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real work, licensing, ignorance of the hidden, and conditional intercession; I infer that dependence blocks elevation into shared rule. A live alternative is that these scenes illustrate separate miracles and need not define the category of partner.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies every meaningful action by any nondivine being.
changed_reading.after: The focus permits delegated action but demands proof for the illicit upgrade from dependent agent to independent partner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence operationalizes the focus challenge as a relational audit. The alleged powers must be summonable and must show some ownership, shared stake, supporting capacity, or authorized mediation; each route is denied or subordinated.

activation_trace.role: Attachment names the relation that the preceding audit decomposes into possible functions.
Calling by speech supplies a practical summons before the later demand to show.
A statement without certainty marks the partner-status as claimant-supplied rather than evidenced.
Ownership and disposal supply the first operative relation explicitly denied.
An actual shared stake supplies the second relation explicitly denied.
Back-strengthening and aid supply the third relation explicitly denied.
Joining another's case supplies the final mediating relation, effective only conditionally.
Permission places even valid mediation under the authority it cannot share.

structural_cues: 34:22 moves through atom-sized ownership, share, and backing under repeated comprehensive negation.
34:23 appends intercession but gates it with permission.
34:24-27 repeat قُلْ as a sequence of tests rather than a single isolated retort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered series of denied relations; I read the series as an operational audit whose conclusion is the demand to show the attached partners. It may instead be cumulative emphasis without an intended taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: The command asks only for the names or visible bodies of idols.
changed_reading.after: The command asks claimants to exhibit any valid ownership, share, support, or authorized mediation by which their candidates function as partners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior promise to gather the parties and open between them by truth turns the focus imperative into an evidentiary moment within anticipated adjudication. Showing the alleged partners is not only observational; it is production of the claimed relation before the One who judges it.

activation_trace.role: Causative presentation supplies the evidentiary act demanded in the next speech.
Judgment seals the focus as an adjudication of the alleged relation.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the court-like assembly.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the decisive separation between claims.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard by which the displayed relation is judged.

structural_cues: 34:25 separates each side's responsibility before 34:26 gathers them.
The sequence in 34:26 is gathering, then judicial opening by truth, followed immediately by the focus command.
The focus ends with الْحَكِيمُ after its evidentiary demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, judicial opening, truth, and the next command to present; I connect them as assembly followed by production of evidence. A live alternative is that 34:27 begins a fresh polemical question rather than a courtroom phase.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a free-standing rhetorical taunt.
changed_reading.after: The ayah anticipates a hearing: produce the supposed co-parties and their title before truth separates the litigants.

context_deltas.mechanism: False affiliation is socially enacted. Following occurs without coercive authority, then the later weak/arrogant exchange exposes prestige, persistent command, and deliberate making as the machinery that installs rivals. The second-person plural in the focus assigns the community responsibility for the attachment even while influence is unequal.

activation_trace.role: Assigned affiliation supplies the status that social actors collectively manufacture.
Loyal following supplies the behavioral vehicle by which a claim acquires a community.
The denied power and jurisdiction show that the following was not produced by irresistible authority.
Lack of strength identifies the socially subordinate side of the partner-making exchange.
Self-magnification identifies the prestige-bearing side that directs the exchange.
Demand and obligation supply the repeated pressure exerted by the dominant group.
Making something assume a state supplies the explicit production of rival-status.
A contrary equal supplies the status into which the commanded objects are made.

structural_cues: 34:20 pairs following with the absence of coercive authority in 34:21.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between those made weak and those acting great.
34:33 locates the command to make rivals inside repeated night-and-day scheming, yet ends by requiting what all parties did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary following, unequal social position, command, and explicit making of rivals; I infer a collective production process behind أَلْحَقْتُم. The alternative is to treat each person's assent as the only causal level and the hierarchy as merely exculpatory argument.

changed_reading.before: Attaching partners is a private intellectual mistake by isolated worshipers.
changed_reading.after: Attaching partners is a socially administered status-production in which leaders command, followers ratify, and neither side can transfer responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later gathering supplies an enacted answer to 'show me.' The beings toward whom worship was directed are brought into a direct question, but their own speech purges the claimed affiliation and redirects allegiance to God; the next verse removes every capacity for mutual benefit or harm.

activation_trace.role: Showing anchors the later scene as a possible performed answer to the focus demand.
Attributed affiliation identifies what the questioned beings themselves repudiate.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination makes the alleged relation present for confrontation.
Submissive worship specifies the actual human conduct put to the questioned beings.
Purging and exoneration supply the beings' repudiation of the attached status.
Allegiance and protective loyalty are redirected exclusively to God rather than the worshipers.
The loss of disposal between parties removes any operative mutual control.
Benefit names one practical capacity that the alleged relation cannot deliver.
Harm completes the practical polarity that the alleged partners cannot control.

structural_cues: 34:40 asks the assembled beings أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ, turning reference into direct confrontation.
34:41 repeats بَلْ while the questioned beings reject the worshipers' assigned relation.
34:42 follows the disavowal with no mutual ownership of benefit or harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, direct questioning, disavowal, and incapacity; I read this later scene as the dramatic fulfillment of the focus's ostensive test. It may instead be a thematic echo rather than a proleptic scene encoded in 34:27.

changed_reading.before: The challenge succeeds because no candidate can be physically produced.
changed_reading.after: Candidates may be brought and pointed to, but their own testimony dissolves the alleged affiliation; the missing object is a valid partnership relation, not a visible being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The epithet الْعَزِيزُ is sharpened by a surah-wide pursuit pattern. Opponents try to outstrip the signs, are made present, and finally encounter no escape before being seized from near; a supposed partner therefore cannot function as an exit, counterforce, or rescue capacity.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and subduing power supplies the divine predicate tested by attempted evasion.
Attempted outstripping and escape introduce the contest that the epithet resolves.
Repetition of attempted escape shows a sustained strategy rather than an isolated boast.
Being brought into presence reverses the attempt to remain beyond reach.
Failure of reach or escape closes the possibility of outrunning judgment.
Capture and seizure give the no-escape pattern its concrete endpoint.

structural_cues: The same مُعَاجِزِينَ formulation occurs near the opening in 34:5 and after the focus in 34:38.
34:38 converts attempted outstripping into forced presence.
34:51 closes with فَلَا فَوْتَ and seizure from a near place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted evasion, forced presence, no escape, and capture; I infer that الْعَزِيزُ denies any partner capable of furnishing an exit. The alternative is that the pursuit sequence concerns rejection of signs generally, not the function assigned to partners.

changed_reading.before: الْعَزِيزُ is a general honorific for superior strength.
changed_reading.after: الْعَزِيزُ answers a concrete escape strategy: no attached power can outstrip, counterforce, or extract anyone from His reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the surah's metalworking and image-making vocabulary into a theological relation. It remains anchored in the causative attachment أَلْحَقْتُم and the shared structure of شُرَكَاءَ, while measured linking and manufactured forms provide a coherent material analogy. Downstream prose should present it only as a fabrication metaphor, not as the lexical meaning of the focus words.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing onto another anchors the material analogy in the focus construction.
Constructing a shared stake supplies the conceptual object produced by the joining.
Repeated purposeful making supplies the crafted-action side of the analogy.
Sizing a thing to its proper measure supplies deliberate construction rather than accidental contact.
Piercing and linking rings supplies the concrete image of assembled attachment.
A fashioned representation supplies the visible product onto which agency can be projected.

changed_reading.before: The claimants merely choose preexisting partners.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they fabricate a relational assembly, fastening represented powers onto God as deliberately as rings or forms are constructed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunter's-snare branch of ش ر ك rather than the ordinary partner branch. It remains root-anchored and gains a visible follow-to-capture mechanism from the surah. Downstream prose must call it a snare-like echo of false partnership, never translate شُرَكَاءَ as snares.

activation_trace.role: The hunter's entangling device supplies the outlier image latent in the partnership root.
Following in another's track supplies voluntary movement into the entangling relation.
Failure to get beyond reach supplies the closed-trap condition.
Capture and seizure complete the snare-like sequence.

changed_reading.before: False partners are only ineffective allies outside the worshiper.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-image echo, the attachments become self-entered snares: following the claimed allies terminates in inescapable capture.

strongest_changes: The command to show becomes a functional audit of ownership, share, backing, and permission-gated mediation.
The surah distinguishes real delegated agency from the unsupported promotion of an agent into a partner.
The prior truth-judgment scene and later gathered disavowal turn the focus into an anticipated evidentiary confrontation.
The plural act of attachment becomes a social production involving prestige, command, following, and retained responsibility.
الْعَزِيزُ acquires a no-escape force from repeated attempted outstripping, forced presence, and capture.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed a short denial into a test of relation rather than mere visibility: candidates can exist, act, and even be presented, yet no valid shared title survives operational audit or their own testimony. Material crafting and snare branches remained live only as contained exploratory overlays.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 34:40-42 is intentionally a dramatic fulfillment of 34:27 or only a strong thematic echo.
Whether the forged-affiliation branch should enter ordinary prose or remain an exploratory juridical analogy.
Whether the four denied relations in 34:22-23 form an intended exhaustive taxonomy.
Whether the crafted-attachment and snare images add explanatory value beyond their diagnostic role as branch activations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The demand exposes partnership as an attachment operation.** `ر ء ي/B013` is the “tell/show me” formula, `ل ح ق/B002` attached affiliation, `ش ر ك/B001` partnership, `ع ز ز/B001` might, and `ح ك م/B004` decisive firmness. The imperative asks for visible candidates, while `ألحقتم` locates the decisive act in their attachment of affiliates. Showing tests the object, attachment explains its manufactured relation, and the final attributes relocate cohesion and decisiveness in God alone. The packet gives challenge and correction; I infer that alleged partnership depends on human linkage rather than discovered capacity. The ayah reads `كلا` as severing an artificial attachment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:40-41 made the artificial attachment answer in person and explicitly disown the worship relation, completing the visual challenge posed here.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Partnership as a manufactured attachment.** `ل ح ق B002` supplies attached affiliation or claimed lineage, `ش ر ك B001` sharing, and `ر ء ي B012` showing something to another. The command demands visible presentation of those whom the addressees themselves attached; 34:22 has already denied any actual share, and 34:26 has separated by truth. The branches make attachment the human operation and showing the evidentiary test. The packet supplies actor-marked annexation and failed ownership; I infer that partnership exists here as a constructed relation. The ayah reads as de-annexing claimed partners from God.

2. **Wisdom as the restraint closing false attachment.** `ح ك م B001` supplies restraining and turning back to set right. `كَلَّا` interrupts the exhibition request and the title `ٱلْحَكِيمُ` closes the correction. The branch assigns wisdom the role of a boundary against annexation. The packet supplies the abrupt reversal; I infer that corrective restraint is enacted in the syntax. The divine title becomes the operation that blocks the false link.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:31-32 extended the attachment mechanism into social causality: weakened followers had attached decisive power to dominant leaders, while leaders denied being the barrier. This showed that false annexation operates in human hierarchy as well as worship claims.

findings.text: Ortaklık, bulunup gösterilen gerçek bir kapasite değil, insanların Allah'a sonradan eklediği yapay bir bağdır; gösterme talebi bu bağı kanıt sınavına sokup koparır.
Hikmet, yapay ortaklık bağını durdurup ilişki sınırını yeniden doğrultan bir kısıtlama olarak cümlede bizzat işler.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Dialogue first keeps opposed positions and liabilities distinct, then gathers the parties so truth can sort valid relations from fabricated attachments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Rhetorical symmetry is temporary rather than relativizing: separated accounts preserve responsibility until adjudication can expose false affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Assembly Judges and Detaches
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Dispersed parties are gathered, judgment opens between them in truth, and alleged partners are exposed as persons wrongly attached to an affiliation.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşıma, yukarı kalkma ve yüklenerek hareket etme çizgilerinin birlikte özetlenmesi gereken kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya başka bir taşıyıcının bir nesnenin ağırlığını üstlenmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı kalkma ile uçuş için yerden ayrılma değerlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yolculuk yüklerini alarak bulunduğu yerden ayrılması bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yükü taşımanın yanında yükselme, havalanma ve yüklenerek ayrılma anlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yükü taşıma eyleminden çok onu taşıyacak güce sahip olmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yükün ağırlığını karşılayacak gücü ve taşıma yeterliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Taşıma yeterliği ortak olsa da bu kol fiilî taşıma ve yerden yükselme yönlerine açılır; komşu kol güç yetirme sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol yük üstlenmeyi, kuşun havalanmasını ve yolcuların yüklenerek ayrılmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kişinin oturduğu yerden kalkmasını ve bir nesneyi bulunduğu yerden kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da aşağıdaki veya durağan bir konumdan kalkma ve hareket başlangıcını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yükselmeyi taşıma ve yolculukla bağlar; komşu kol bedensel olarak ayağa kalkma ve nesneyi yerinden kaldırma çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda yolculuk anlamı yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılmasıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; taşıma gücü, yerden kalkma ve yolculuğa başlama komşuları bu kolun üç kurucu yönünü en az yinelemeyle açıklar.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد القلة العددية، ولا قلة الجبل، ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقل الجرة أطاق حملها؛ استقلت السماء ارتفعت؛ استقل القوم مضوا وارتحلوا (sihah)؛ أقل الرجل الشيء واستقله إذا احتمله؛ استقل الطائر إذا نهض للطيران؛ استقل النبات أناف؛ استقل القوم إذا احتملوا ظاعنين؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي حملت؛ قل إذا رفع وقل إذا علا (tahdhib)؛ أقلت سحابا ثقالا أي احتملته؛ أقللت كذا وجدته قليل المحمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol titremenin korku veya öfkeden doğmasını anlam sınırının parçası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insandaki titreme veya silkinişi belirli bir duygusal nedenle sınırlamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insan bedeninde ortaya çıkan titreme veya silkinişi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bedensel olay aynıdır; bu kol korku ve öfke koşulunu taşırken komşu kart neden bakımından daha genel kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol korkunun yanında öfkeyi de titremenin belirleyici nedeni olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol hastalık, gevşeklik, yumuşaklık ve korkaklıkla ilişkili titremeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da özellikle korku sırasında insanda görülen titreme ve ürpermede örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Korkuya bağlı kullanımda yakınlaşırlar; bu kol öfkeyi ekler, komşu kol ise hastalık ve bedensel gevşeklik gibi başka nedenlere açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel insan titremesi ve nedenleri daha geniş ürperme alanı, bu kolun kişi ve duygu sınırını en iyi gösterir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القل الرعدة والانتفاض؛ أخذ فلانا القل إذا أخذته رعدة من فزع (jamhara)؛ القل بالكسر شبه الرعدة؛ أخذه قل من الغضب (sihah)؛ القل الرعدة؛ أخذه قل إذا أرعد من الغضب؛ إذا غضب قد استقل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin yerinde duramamasını ve hareket sırasında çıkan sesi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol kalp, deniz, diş, ağaç ve gök gürültüsü gibi alanlardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol insanda korku veya öfke yüzünden ortaya çıkan titremeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel sallama, hareketten doğan ses ve aynı kökteki duygusal titreme karşılaştırmaları fiziksel hareket çekirdeğinin sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: gözle ya da içsel kavrayışla görme
concept_gloss.applicability: Duyusal görme ile ona benzetilen içsel kavrayışın birlikte amaçlandığı genel anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gözle algılama çekirdeğini ve içsel kavrayış uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım yalnızca duyusal algıyı veya doğrudan göz tanıklığını gerektirdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyusal görmeyi ve doğrudan tanıklığı açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İçsel kavrayışla görme olanağını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle değil, zihinsel veya içsel bir kavrayışla algılama bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göz işlevine benzetilen içsel algılama yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Duyusal görme ve doğrudan göz tanıklığı yönünü yitirir.

error_profile.adds: Bir konu hakkında düşünce veya kanı anlamını öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Zihinsel yargı dalıyla kolayca karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışa uzanabilmesi ve doğrudan tanıklık anlatımlarını kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göz duyusunu, gören organı ve bakışın fiziksel açılışını ayrıca adlandırması.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da göz yoluyla görsel algılamayı merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algılanan şeyi görme eylemini ve bunun içsel kavrayış uzantısını anlatır; komşu dal ise göz duyusunu ve gözün görür duruma getirilmesini de kendi çekirdeğine alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İçsel kavrayışı ve genel görsel algıyı doğrudan tanıklığın yanında kapsaması.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüz yüze görme ile kesinlik ve ilk elden tanıklık vurgusunu çekirdeğe yerleştirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi doğrudan gözle görme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kapsamı genel görmeden içsel kavrayışa uzanır; komşu dal doğrudan karşılaşma ve gözle kesin tanıklık sınırında daha dardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi algılamış olmayı ve görmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi anlamak için bakışı sürdürme, sınama ve dikkatle inceleme sürecini bildirmesi.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gözün bir nesneye yönelmesini gerektirebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal algının sonucunu veya gerçekleşmesini anlatır; komşu dal ise algıya ulaşmak için yapılan dikkatli ve süreli bakışı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sağlanan adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; göz duyusu, doğrudan tanıklık ve dikkatli bakış en yararlı sınırları verdi, öteki adaylar ya uzak temalıydı ya da bu ayrımları yineledi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الرأي المجرد ولا الرؤيا المنامية ولا الرياء
